root_cause: Server correctly refuses checkout without Stripe secrets, but the public website still displays an immediately enabled payment form and asks for business/email information before giving the known billing_not_configured message. The first protected admission correctly rejected a Playwright helper outside tests/ as the sole historical replay/shadow/canary path; a proper Node test oracle is required.
fix: Use the existing public GET /api/checkout/readiness to gate form input and submit readiness. Fail closed on non-200/missing status/network error; display the already-shipped Dutch billing unavailable copy. When ready, preserve the existing Stripe checkout; never block the separately verified success/activation return. Add fixture-only browser tests desktop/mobile NL/EN for disabled state and no checkout-create call. Add a dedicated tests/*.test.mjs source-and-fixture regression, while keeping the existing Playwright browser scenario for desktop/mobile and both languages.
prevention_rule: Do not collect personal company/email form inputs or create payment attempts when the canonical server payment readiness is blocked or unreachable. In a provider outage show an explicit accessible status; never infer payment from a URL, and never create a second billing authority or scheduler.

invariants: no form input or checkout-create calls before verified readiness
success-readback not gated by public payment availability
